card.name: Inside drug names in interaction text
card.fires_on: Early pieces of long drug names (SYMTUZA, ritonavir, bosentan, simvastatin, aminoglycoside) in drug-interaction or dosing-resumption sentences. A few weaker hits fall on linking words like "as" and "so" in technical prose.

modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug-class or condition word such as aminoglycoside or arrhythmias.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are odd fragments like oct and Plane, so it seems to steer away from food and chemistry-reaction words.
card.plain: It fires inside long drug names, mostly where a label discusses interactions or restarting another drug.
